shared_widgets.name: ShopEaseAppBar
shared_widgets.description: Material 3 AppBar using surface background, text_primary title, optional leading back (min 48dp), trailing actions (search, cart with badge, account) each min 48×48dp with Semantics labels. Cart badge shows item count from CartNotifier.

shared_widgets.name: ShopEaseBottomNav
shared_widgets.description: Four-tab NavigationBar (Home, Search, Cart, Account) bound to go_router ShellRoute; selected state uses primary; labels use label typography; min 48dp tap height per destination.

shared_widgets.name: PrimaryButton
shared_widgets.description: FilledButton using primary background and text_on_primary; min height 48dp, horizontal padding spacing 24; button typography; Semantics button role with explicit label.

shared_widgets.name: SecondaryButton
shared_widgets.description: OutlinedButton with primary border and text_primary label; min 48dp; for secondary actions (Continue shopping, Sign in).

shared_widgets.name: TextLinkButton
shared_widgets.description: TextButton for inline legal links, Forgot password, and Remove item; min 48dp touch padding via TapTargetSize/shrinkWrap false; primary color text.

shared_widgets.name: ProductCard
shared_widgets.description: Grid/list tile: ProductImage, name (title, max 2 lines), brand (caption), PriceText, AvailabilityBadge, optional wishlist IconButton (48dp). Entire card tappable to product detail. Semantics merges name, price, availability.

shared_widgets.name: ProductImage
shared_widgets.description: Aspect-ratio image (1:1 list, 4:3 detail) with corner radius 12, image_placeholder fill, BoxFit.cover, required semanticLabel with product name.

shared_widgets.name: PriceText
shared_widgets.description: Formats integer minor units (cents) + ISO 4217 USD as $X.XX using int math only; price typography; optional strikethrough variant for compare-at; Semantics announces full currency phrase.

shared_widgets.name: MoneySummaryRow
shared_widgets.description: Label/value row for subtotal, discount, shipping, estimated tax, total using body/label styles; total uses price typography; used in cart footer and checkout review.

shared_widgets.name: AvailabilityBadge
shared_widgets.description: Pill chip showing In stock, Low stock, or Out of stock with token colors availability_*; caption typography; never color-only—always includes text.

shared_widgets.name: CategoryChip
shared_widgets.description: Tappable chip for Clothing, Electronics, Home & Kitchen, Beauty, Sports & Outdoors; surface_variant fill, border, min 48dp when standalone; navigates to search with category filter.

shared_widgets.name: BannerCarousel
shared_widgets.description: Horizontal PageView of promo banners from GET /home; 16:9 images with banner_overlay gradient, headline on banner; page indicators; auto Semantics for each banner title.

shared_widgets.name: SectionHeader
shared_widgets.description: Row with headline title and optional See all TextLinkButton (48dp); used for Featured, New arrivals, Categories on home.

shared_widgets.name: HorizontalProductList
shared_widgets.description: Horizontal ListView of compact ProductCard variants for featured and new arrivals sections.

shared_widgets.name: SearchBarField
shared_widgets.description: TextField with search icon, hint Search products, submit on keyboard action; min 48dp height; label Search; clear button when non-empty.

shared_widgets.name: SortFilterBar
shared_widgets.description: Row of FilterChip buttons: Sort (bottom sheet: price low-high, price high-low, newest) and Filters (opens FilterBottomSheet); each chip min 48dp.

shared_widgets.name: FilterBottomSheet
shared_widgets.description: Modal sheet for price range slider, multi-select category, brand (8–12 seeded), availability (in stock, low stock, out of stock); Apply and Clear all Primary/Secondary buttons min 48dp.

shared_widgets.name: QuantityStepper
shared_widgets.description: Minus/plus IconButtons in 48dp containers with quantity label; disables plus at max stock; announces quantity changes.

shared_widgets.name: CartLineItem
shared_widgets.description: Row: thumbnail, name, unit price snapshot (cents USD), QuantityStepper, line total, remove control; min row height 72dp; out-of-stock line shows error caption and blocks checkout.

shared_widgets.name: WishlistToggle
shared_widgets.description: Heart IconButton 48dp; filled when wishlisted; guest persists locally, signed-in via API; Semantics Add to wishlist / Remove from wishlist.

shared_widgets.name: AuthTextField
shared_widgets.description: Email/password/name fields with validation messages, obscure toggle on password, error color for field errors; min 56dp touch height.

shared_widgets.name: TabLoginRegister
shared_widgets.description: TabBar with Login and Register tabs on AuthScreen; indicator primary; tab min 48dp.

shared_widgets.name: CheckoutStepperHeader
shared_widgets.description: Linear step indicator: Shipping, Review & coupon, Payment; current step highlighted primary.

shared_widgets.name: AddressForm
shared_widgets.description: US-only fields: full name, email, phone, address1, address2 optional, city, state (dropdown US contiguous), ZIP; client validation before quote; uses AuthTextField styling.

shared_widgets.name: CouponField
shared_widgets.description: Row: text field for single coupon code, Apply button 48dp; shows applied code chip with remove; inline error text for invalid, expired, minimum not met, excluded items, stacking blocked.

shared_widgets.name: OrderStatusStepper
shared_widgets.description: Horizontal stepper shopper labels Processing → Shipped → Delivered; maps server paid/fulfilled→processing, fulfilled+tracking→shipped, delivered→delivered; current step primary, future steps disabled color.

shared_widgets.name: TrackingInfoCard
shared_widgets.description: Surface card showing carrier name and tracking number when status shipped or delivered; copy-to-clipboard icon 48dp with Semantics Copy tracking number.

shared_widgets.name: LoadingStateView
shared_widgets.description: Centered CircularProgressIndicator primary with optional caption; liveRegion for screen readers.

shared_widgets.name: EmptyStateView
shared_widgets.description: Illustration placeholder, headline, body, optional PrimaryButton CTA; used for empty cart, wishlist, orders, search results.

shared_widgets.name: ErrorStateView
shared_widgets.description: Error icon error color, message body, Retry PrimaryButton 48dp; optional Sign in CTA for auth-gated screens.

shared_widgets.name: GuestMergeBanner
shared_widgets.description: Info banner after login when guest cart replaced merged cart per API; body explains items combined or guest cart applied fallback.

shared_widgets.name: WishlistImportDialog
shared_widgets.description: One-time alert dialog on login/register when local guest wishlist non-empty: Import favorites / Not now; Primary and Secondary 48dp.

shared_widgets.name: SupportForm
shared_widgets.description: Fields: name, email, subject, message (required); Send PrimaryButton; success shows confirmation banner; copy states response within 1–2 business days.

shared_widgets.name: LegalDocumentBody
shared_widgets.description: Scrollable static markdown/plain text from lib/core/legal for Privacy Policy or Terms of Sale; title headline typography.

shared_widgets.name: MockPaymentCard
shared_widgets.description: Demo UI styled like PaymentIntent stub: order summary, Pay now PrimaryButton, Cancel SecondaryButton; no card fields; disclaimer caption demo payment only.

shared_widgets.name: OrderConfirmationHeader
shared_widgets.description: Success icon success color, headline Thank you, order number display title typography, body with email receipt copy for demo.

shared_widgets.name: ExpandableOrderCard
shared_widgets.description: Order history list tile: order number, date, total PriceText, status label; expands to show line items, address summary, OrderStatusStepper, TrackingInfoCard when applicable.

screens.name: AuthScreen
screens.purpose: Register and log in with email/password tabs; links to forgot password and legal documents; on success stores JWT via flutter_secure_storage and triggers cart merge and optional wishlist import.

screens.name: PasswordResetScreen
screens.purpose: Mock forgot-password flow: step 1 submit registered email shows demo sent confirmation; step 2 enter and confirm new password meeting registration rules; no real email delivery.

screens.name: HomeScreen
screens.purpose: Merchandised storefront entry: promotional banners, featured products, new arrivals, and category chips for seeded categories; primary tab in bottom nav.

screens.name: SearchResultsScreen
screens.purpose: Keyword catalog discovery with sort (price low/high, newest) and filters (price range, category, brand, availability); shows USD prices from integer cents; bottom nav Search tab.

screens.name: ProductDetailScreen
screens.purpose: M1 baseline detail extended with availability UX: blocks or warns add-to-cart when out of stock; wishlist toggle; navigates from home, search, wishlist.

screens.name: CartScreen
screens.purpose: Guest local or signed-in API cart with line items, quantities, subtotal; merge on login; proceed to checkout when in stock; bottom nav Cart tab.

screens.name: WishlistScreen
screens.purpose: Saved favorites: local persistence for guests, API sync when signed in; add/remove; navigate to product detail; reachable from account and product cards.

screens.name: CheckoutScreen
screens.purpose: Stepped checkout: US shipping/contact address, order review with line snapshots, flat shipping or free above threshold, estimated tax after discounts, single coupon apply with server quote recalc.

screens.name: MockPaymentScreen
screens.purpose: Demo payment stub: POST order then complete-mock-payment; Pay now without card data; cancel releases reservation; on success navigates to confirmation with order number.

screens.name: OrderConfirmationScreen
screens.purpose: Post-purchase confirmation showing human-readable order number, total, and CTAs to order history or continue shopping.

screens.name: AccountScreen
screens.purpose: Signed-in hub: profile email, links to orders and wishlist, embedded SupportForm and support email, legal links, log out, delete account; guests see sign-in prompt.

screens.name: OrderHistoryScreen
screens.purpose: Signed-in order list most recent first; guest redirect to auth; expandable order cards show detail, status stepper, and tracking without separate detail route.

navigation.trigger: Tap bottom nav Search or AppBar search action → /search
Tap bottom nav Cart or cart icon with badge → /cart
Tap Add to cart → snackbar optional then user opens cart
WishlistToggle on → item saved; user opens /wishlist from account
Tap Checkout PrimaryButton when cart non-empty and stock valid → /checkout
Tap Sign in to sync cart (optional CTA) → /auth

Tap Privacy Policy or Terms TextLinkButton → push /legal?document=privacy|terms (LegalDocumentScreen implemented as route overlay using LegalDocumentBody; not counted as 13th shopper screen—content route shares SCR-11 legal links)
After successful reset tap Back to login → /auth
Successful login/register → go_router redirect /home with cart merge
Continue to payment on valid address and quote → /checkout/payment
Cancel payment → pop to checkout review
Guest opens /orders → redirect prompt Sign in → /auth
Support form submit success stays on account; orders link as above

accessibility: All tappable controls meet minimum 48×48 dp touch targets including IconButtons, chips, ProductCard hit areas, bottom nav items, and stepper controls.
text_primary on background and surface, and text_on_primary on primary, meet WCAG AA contrast ratio ≥4.5:1 for body text (16sp) and ≥3:1 for large text (price, headlines).
error, success, and availability badge colors pair with text labels—never convey stock or errors by color alone.
Every ProductImage, banner, and actionable icon includes a non-empty Semantics label or semanticLabel describing purpose (e.g. product name, Add to cart, Open cart, Remove from wishlist).
PriceText announces accessible currency strings derived from integer cents (e.g. 12 dollars and 99 cents) rather than raw API integers.
LoadingStateView, EmptyStateView, and ErrorStateView use Semantics liveRegion or assertive announcements when async state changes.
OrderStatusStepper exposes current step and step names to screen readers; TrackingInfoCard fields are focusable with copy action labeled.
Auth and AddressForm fields associate validation errors with fields via Semantics for error text.
SupportForm required fields announce errors on submit failure; success confirmation is announced.
Text scaling up to 200% must not clip primary CTAs on checkout and payment—use scrollable layouts and flexible line heights from typography tokens.
Mock payment screen states clearly in Semantics that no card entry is required and payment is demo-only.
go_router back navigation preserves logical focus order; AppBar back labeled Go back.
WishlistImportDialog and delete-account confirmation use modal Semantics with title and action buttons ≥48dp.
FilterBottomSheet traps focus while open and returns focus to Filters chip on close.
Minimum spacing scale uses 8dp and 16dp for readable tap gaps between dense list items.
